display.purpose: Composer topic textarea, animated stat numbers (WrapReport), the REC line's rotating caption (PlayfulCaption).

title.purpose: Page/dialog headings, job-card topic, EmptyState headline, clip-block segment titles.

body.purpose: Default UI/body text, form copy, menu items, toasts.

label.purpose: Instrument captions, clip-track timecodes, pills, nav links, meter/status readouts.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for Card, active Tabs trigger, resting clip block.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Overlay elevation: Dialog, DropdownMenu, Tooltip, toasts, JobCard hover.

motion.name: duration-1
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: button lift, tab color transitions.

motion.name: duration-2
motion.purpose: Small overlays: toast/dialog opacity, hover sheen fade, tier-color-bar transitions.

motion.name: duration-3
motion.purpose: Reserved slower step in the token scale (largest defined duration).

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Default motion easing across the app: button hover, card entrance, tier badge flip, clip-track playhead glide.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Defined standard easing token (secondary to ease-expo-out, which dominates actual usage).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action; accent fill, pointer-tracked hover sheen and glow ring, app-wide focus-visible ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:#e8542f; color:#fbfaf6; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 16px; font-family:'Geist Variable',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #e8542f, 0 6px 20px -6px #e8542f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e8542f; outline-offset:2px; border-radius:6px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0) scale(.985); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Mono-caps status token; tone maps to job status (queued/running/succeeded/failed).
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; border-radius:9999px; padding:4px 10px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace; font-size:11px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0.05em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-pill-ok { background:rgba(30,122,84,0.12); color:#1e7a54; }

components.name: Clip Track
components.description: Signature component: a broadcast-timeline rail with a deterministic hash-seeded waveform, an accent fill keyed to real phase progress, and a sweeping playhead with a pulsing halo.
components.css: .ds-clip-track { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1px; height:36px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:10px; background:#e7e4d8; padding:0 8px; } .ds-bar { flex:1; min-width:1px; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(168,163,146,0.35); transition:background-color 300ms; } .ds-bar-fill { background:rgba(232,84,47,0.7); } .ds-playhead { position:absolute; top:50%; left:60%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(232,84,47,0.4); }

components.name: Clip Block (Segment Card)
components.description: A segment rendered as an NLE clip block: literal tier-color fill bar across the top edge, timecode-formatted duration.
components.css: .ds-clip-block { display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden; border-radius:16px; border:1px solid rgba(168,163,146,0.25); background:#f3f1e9; text-align:left; } .ds-clip-block-tier { height:6px; width:100%; background:#2f6fe8; } .ds-clip-block-body { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; padding:16px; } .ds-clip-block-index { font-family:'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace; font-size:11px; color:#6b6759; } .ds-clip-block-title { font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque Variable',sans-serif; font-size:16px; color:#16150f; } .ds-clip-block-duration { font-family:'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace; font-size:11px; color:#6b6759; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard raised container: job cards, live-progress panel, wrap-report panel.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius:16px; border:1px solid rgba(168,163,146,0.25); background:#f3f1e9; padding:20px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(22,21,15,0.06), 0 0 0 1px rgba(22,21,15,0.05); }

components.name: Composer Input
components.description: The single free-text topic field, set in display type rather than body type.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-input-topic" rows="3" placeholder="Teach me about SQL injection"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-input-topic { resize:none; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid rgba(168,163,146,0.3); background:#fbfaf6; padding:12px 16px; font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque Variable',sans-serif; font-size:24px; color:#16150f; } .ds-input-topic::placeholder { color:#a8a392; } .ds-input-topic:focus { border-color:#e8542f; outline:none; } .ds-input-topic:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e8542f; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Segmented control; paper-2 track, raised active trigger.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:inline-flex; gap:4px; border-radius:10px; background:#e7e4d8; padding:4px; } .ds-tab { border-radius:6px; padding:6px 12px; font-family:'Geist Variable',sans-serif; font-size:14px; color:#3a382e; background:transparent; border:none; } .ds-tab-active { background:#fbfaf6; color:#16150f; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(22,21,15,0.06), 0 0 0 1px rgba(22,21,15,0.05); }

narrative.overview: T37 re-grounded the console in a broadcast/NLE production-timeline vocabulary (Premiere/Descript/Resolve) rather than the six-equal-widget dashboard the previous pass shipped. The product's own mechanism -- duration-locked segments assembled into a video -- IS a timeline, and the UI now says so directly: a horizontal clip track with a real waveform, a sweeping playhead, and timecodes replaces the prior ring-and-tick 'production strip' as the page's one focal instrument. This was the user's explicit, informed choice ('Impeccable's Pick') over the tool's own anti-rut assignment. The warm paper-and-ink neutral system and the single industrial-orange accent carry over unchanged from the prior system -- this is a re-staging of the same material world around a new signature device, not a palette or type replacement. Dark mode is no longer OS-driven: it is light-only, always; data-theme="dark" remains a complete token set but is an unwired future opt-in, not a live feature.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper neutrals + one industrial accent, applied narrowly
A horizontal clip track (waveform + sweeping playhead + timecodes) as the one focal live-progress instrument, not a row of six equal-weight widgets
Display type (Bricolage Grotesque) for numbers and headings, mono (JetBrains Mono) for uppercase labels, timecodes, and instrument readouts, sans (Geist) for body/UI text
Soft, low-contrast ambient shadows only -- no hard offset shadows, no heavy elevation
Real, state-driven motion and data only -- waveform bars are deterministic (hashed, not random), playhead and timecodes read off actual SSE event timestamps, never a timer
Light-only by design; dark-mode tokens are complete but intentionally unwired
One consistent inline-SVG icon system app-wide; no unicode glyphs standing in for icons

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: --color-accent is the only saturated color outside the signal set; it marks exactly one primary action or one 'this is live right now' state per view. It is never used for large fills or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Signal-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: signal-run/ok/warn/bad exist only to report real job/status state -- a status vocabulary, not a general decorative palette.

rules.name: The Tier-Is-Literal-Color Rule
rules.body: tier-0/1/2 render as the literal fill color of a segment's clip block -- tier is read off the color, not inferred from a label. Depends on domain/tier.ts's fixed --color-tier-N binding.

rules.name: The Mono-Caps Instrument Rule
rules.body: Any text describing a measured quantity, status, or timecode renders in uppercase JetBrains Mono at 11px with wide tracking, tabular-nums where numeric -- never the display or body face.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse and low-opacity; a hard-offset/outlined shadow would contradict the paper-and-ink editorial register.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, wide-tracked, tabular-nums, for any label describing a measured value, status, or timecode.
Do keep shadows soft and ambient (Shadow 1 / Shadow 2 only).
Do redefine color tokens under identical names for dark mode rather than adding dark: variants, even while dark mode itself stays unwired.
Do drive animated state (waveform fill, playhead position, timecodes, counts, badges) from real backend data, never a fabricated timer or invented percentage.
Do put the live progress view's segments on a horizontal clip strip/track, never a wrapping card grid; reserve the card grid for the finished/browse view.
Do use the shared components/icons.tsx inline-SVG set for any icon; never a unicode glyph or emoji.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent color.
Don't add hard-offset or high-contrast drop shadows.
Don't let the OS/browser prefers-color-scheme drive the palette; the app is light-only, always, by explicit decision (T37/D144).
Don't treat repeated/duplicate phase labels in StageTicker as a design choice to preserve -- it's an upstream backend data gap (segmentTitle not always populated), not a frontend pattern.
